title: Former Printemps CEO Jean-Marc Bellaiche takes the helm at Douglas
summary: Germany-based Douglas Group has appointed Jean-Marc Bellaiche as Chief Executive Officer, effective 1 November 2026. The former Printemps chief will succeed Sander van der Laan, who is retiring after a 36-year career in retail, including four years leading the European premium beauty retailer. Bellaiche's appointment has been approved for a four-year term by the supervisory board of Douglas AG. The 56-year-old French executive brings extensive experience in luxury, beauty and retail.
